Courses taken to satisfy a specialization requirement may not be used to satisfy the technical elective requirements. notes.text: Acceptance into the major: Area of Interest or declared AMS, CSE, DAS and ISE students must complete CSE 114, CSE 214 and one of CSE 113, AMS 261, MAT 203 or MAT 307, with grades of B- or higher and a 3.00 GPA in those courses, repeat at most one of them, have a cumulative GPA of 3.00 or higher, and have course evaluations completed for transferred courses used toward the major. Requirements must be completed within one year of enrolling in the first course that applies toward major entry. Applications are due January 5 (Spring) and June 5 (Fall). Students outside AMS, CSE, DAS and ISE are admitted competitively, contingent on program capacity.
Students majoring in Data Science may not double-major or minor in Computer Science, Information Systems or Applied Mathematics & Statistics.
The program offers a 'Data Science + X' option with a variety of subject areas through its specialization requirement.
An accelerated BS in DAS + MS in DAS program is available to majors, in which nine credits may be applied to both undergraduate and graduate requirements. This optional program is not modeled here.
